# AI Voiceover & Text to Speech Narrator

Turn your own text into a spoken voiceover, paced for listening and returned as an MP3 from your ManyMotions account.

## What it does

Paste the text and say how it should sound (warm narrator, calm and slow, energetic promo, documentary). Claude prepares the request and shows the credits required. When you confirm, ManyMotions adapts the text for speech (pauses, emphasis, emotional cues) in that style and reads it with a stock AI voice.

**AI generation:** the media are generated by AI models run by ManyMotions and its model providers. Nothing is generated until you ask for it, and the credits required are shown first.

Text to speech of your own text, read by one stock AI voice. No voice cloning, no imitation of a real person's voice, no uploaded audio or music. Up to 3,000 characters per request.

## Setup

The plugin connects Claude to the ManyMotions MCP server at `https://manymotions.com/api/claude/ai-voiceover-narrator/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).

- Preparing a request is free and works without an account.
- The first render asks you to sign in to ManyMotions (OAuth with PKCE; you can create an account on the same page). Rendering needs verified paid access and available credits on the account.
- A voiceover takes a minute or two: Claude reports the progress, then returns the MP3 link. Claude Code works the same way, with text and links.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `prepare_voiceover` | Prepare the voiceover: text and delivery style. Free, no sign-in. |
| `generate_result` | Start the voiceover. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_result` | Report progress, then return the MP3 link. Read-only. |

## Example prompts

- "Read this product intro as a warm narrator: Meet Lumen, the desk lamp that follows the sun..."
- "A calm, slow voiceover for this 2-minute meditation script"
- "Energetic promo read of this 30-second ad script for a summer sale"

## Data and privacy

Your prompts and settings are sent to ManyMotions and stored in your ManyMotions account, and they are sent to the model providers that render the media. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.

- Privacy policy: https://manymotions.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://manymotions.com/terms
- Documentation: https://manymotions.com/mcp#ai-voiceover-narrator
- Support: https://manymotions.com/support

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
